name: OpenTTD
description: An open source simulation game based on Transport Tycoon Deluxe.
summary: Issues and pull requests generated by LLMs are not accepted, and using AI to generate entire lines of code is unacceptable. AI may proofread issue and comment text but not write it.

evidence.quote: Please refrain from submitting issues or pull requests that have been generated by an LLM or other fully-automated tools.
Using an AI tool to generate entire lines of code is unacceptable.
Using an AI tool to _proofread_ your issue/comment text is acceptable. Using an AI tool to _write_ your issue/comment text is not.
Using an AI tool to _proofread_ your issue/comment text is acceptable.
